g.text: Activity Diagram - Order XV-A CPC Pre-Trial Case Management Lifecycle
This syntax is deprecated, you must add <<#FADBD8>> at the end of the line, after the ';'
Commercial Plaint Ingestion via e-Filing
System Assigns 16-Digit CNR Number & Validates Claim Value (> ₹3 Lakhs)
Verify e-Challan Court Fees via Cyber Treasury MP
Issue Judicial Summons with Plaint & Documents to Defendant
Defendant Files Written Statement within 30 to 120 Days?
yes
no - 120 days lapsed
Pleadings Declared Complete by Registry
Right to File Defense Forfeited (Order VIII Rule 1 CPC);
:Matter Listed for Ex-Parte Hearing / Judgment
Plaintiff Uploads Statement of Admissions & Denials (Order XI Rule 4)
Defendant Uploads Statement of Admissions & Denials (Order XI Rule 4)
Automated Matrix Engine Computes Admitted vs Disputed Assertions
Clash-Detection Engine Evaluates Advocate Calendars across High Court Benches
Issue Notice of First Case Management Hearing (CMH) (within 4 weeks)
Convene Case Management Hearing (In-Person / WebRTC Split-Screen)
Case Management Hearing (Order XV-A Rule 1 & 2 CPC)
Judge Reviews Narrowed Issues & Evidentiary Exhibits
Parties Agree to Alternative Dispute Resolution - Sec 89 CPC?
yes - Mediation/Arbitration
no - Proceed with Commercial Trial
Refer Matter to Mediation Centre / Lok Adalat
Record Consent Terms
Judge Frames Substantive Triable Issues
Prescribe Statutory Discovery & Trial Timetable (Rule 2)
Set Document Inspection Deadline (<= 15 days)
Set Interrogatories Deadline (<= 15 days)
Set Production of Originals Deadline
Set Witness Affidavits Filing Deadline (<= 15 days)
Schedule Consecutive Trial Dates for Cross-Examination
Schedule Date for Oral Final Arguments
Automated CMO Engine Compiles Official Case Management Order
Hon'ble Judge Digitally Signs CMO (DSC Cryptographic Stamp)
Generate PDF/A Decree & Compute SHA-256 Hash Seal
Persist Sealed Order in Tamper-Proof Document Vault & Audit Ledger
Broadcast Real-Time WebSocket Alerts to Advocate Portals
Automated Discovery Countdown Daemons Activated (Alerts at T-5, T-2 days)
Update Cause List & Sync with National Judicial Data Grid (NJDG)
